mainEntity.name: What makeup services does Nikol Pavlova offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Services include wedding and bridal makeup, evening and cocktail styling, nude/natural makeup, commercial and editorial makeup, and personalized one-on-one makeup courses.
Yes. Nikol provides makeup services in English and Czech, making her well-suited for international clients and destination weddings in Prague.

mainEntity.name: What is included in the wedding makeup package?

acceptedAnswer.text: The wedding package includes a bridal trial, wedding-day makeup application, false lashes, and a touch-up kit for the day.
